# Grounding & Citations Checklist: Dating Coach RAG (MVP Coaching Chat)

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review for RAG grounding, citations, weak-retrieval behavior, and golden evaluation cases
**Created**: 2026-09-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are coaching answers required to use retrieved library material rather than unconstrained chat? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]

- [x] CHK003 Is refuse-or-hedge required when retrieval is empty or weak, including a ban on invented studies/statistics/clinical claims? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, SC-004]
- [x] CHK004 Are the four golden cases (cited answer, unknown, bio rewrite, message rewrite) required as a reviewable set? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, SC-007]
- [x] CHK005 Is the starter library’s topic coverage listed (bio, openers, pacing, boundaries, informational red flags)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]

## Requirement Clarity
